author: David Bombal
description:
AI’s next chapter is about making it accessible to everyone. Open source models could lower costs and give more people access to powerful tools, but safety and trust matter. This conversation explores AI democratization and the role Cisco and Splunk could play in securing that future.

Thank you to Cisco for sponsoring my trip to Splunk .conf26! Time to learn more about Splunk! 
#SplunkConf26 #Splunk #Cisco
title: AI Isn’t Just for Rich People
